conclusion: Detection false positive: all three reported Redis fixtures already existed with identical bytes in v0.98.0. The binary cataloger diff adds ordinary Erlang, Julia and Composer classifiers, not malicious changes to Redis fixtures.
behavior: Non-executable ELF-shaped data fixtures retain header prefixes plus Redis version/build and ziplist/network diagnostic data. Header bytes have been removed and concatenated with data; no usable load mappings, entry point, code, imports or decoded payload were found. Syft default_classifiers.go extracts Redis versions by matching the retained payload %5 and version/build strings, and cataloger_test.go explicitly uses these directories as positive Redis fixtures.
change: Preserve the binary-test-fixture-member ID as a grouping of its original directory matcher and a new bounded test[-_]fixtures? directory matcher. The existing malformed ELF hook uses that context without another suppression clause.
